records.description: A low-power self-powered integrated system for sensing and computing can be created through the monolithic integration of tiers containing graphene-based chemical sensors, two-dimensional semiconductor-based complementary logic and silicon photovoltaic modules.

records.title: A silicon chip for water-based parallel DNA synthesis
records.description: Parallel DNA synthesis is key to high-throughput synthetic biology and diagnostics, and potentially to DNA data storage, but has proved challenging under mild conditions. Now, a silicon chip is developed that enables the parallel enzymatic synthesis of 64 distinct DNA sequences in water through spatially programmed electrochemical pH control.

records.title: Artificial intelligence agents automate life-cycle assessment
records.description: Assessing the carbon emissions of an electronic device from raw material extraction to disposal requires time-intensive data collection for each component. Now, artificial intelligence agents autonomously generate life-cycle inventories for electronic devices in under a minute and estimate carbon emissions with less than 19% deviation from expert assessments.

records.title: Parallel enzymatic DNA synthesis using a semiconductor chip
records.description: An array of 256 ring-electrode pairs fabricated on a complementary metal–oxide–semiconductor integrated circuit that can control local acidity and induce parallel enzymatic DNA synthesis can be used to encode a 169-byte text using DNA as a data storage medium.

records.title: Single-shot in situ readout of a spin qubit unit cell
records.description: The state of a foundry-fabricated spin qubit unit cell, which is composed of two electron spins with a controllable exchange interaction, can be read out in a single shot using gate reflectometry.

records.title: A wirelessly powered, light-controlled, bioresorbable stimulation system with programmable polyphasic waveforms
records.description: Using a bioresorbable silicon phototransistor to optically modulate current flows in electrical circuits, a wirelessly powered stimulation system can be created that offers programmable control over stimulation waveforms with tissue-penetrating near-infrared light.

records.title: Identification of the mode, polarization, wavelength and intensity of light using a one-pixel device on an optical fibre tip
records.description: A one-pixel device that is made of layers of twisted dichroic materials and ring-grating-like electrodes—and is integrated on the tip of an optical fibre—can be used to simultaneously resolve the mode, polarization, wavelength and intensity of input light in one-shot measurements.

records.title: A miniaturized ingestible temperature sensor for continuous internal monitoring
records.description: An ingestible device that integrates a low-power integrated circuit, an antenna for wireless backscatter communication and a coin-cell battery measures just 6 mm in diameter and 4 mm in height, and can provide internal temperature sensing in swine models under diverse physiological and pathophysiological conditions.

records.title: Breaking symmetry yields a low-loss out-of-plane tunable microwave dielectric
records.description: By breaking the out-of-plane symmetry of a Ruddlesden–Popper thin film, a low-loss and tunable microwave dielectric can be created that is compatible with an out-of-plane parallel-plate varactor design.

records.title: Fault-free analogue computing with imperfect hardware
records.description: A matrix representation in which any target matrix is decomposed into the product of two adjustable submatrices allows analogue in-memory computing systems to be immune to hardware faults and increase density.

records.title: Sustainability assessment using multimodal artificial intelligence agents
records.description: A multimodal multi-agent artificial intelligence system that emulates the collaborative process between life-cycle assessment professionals and stakeholders (such as product managers and engineers) can calculate the carbon footprint of electronic devices, performing data collection tasks that can take weeks or months of expert time to under a minute.

records.title: Space-time holograms based on programmable metasurfaces
records.description: Using a fast convergence phase-retrieval algorithm to manipulate wavefront intensities at each harmonic, a programmable metasurface with 6,144 elements can generate 62 holographic images simultaneously.

records.title: Two-dimensional β-TeO 2 as an intrinsic insulator despite conflicting transport signatures
Precise and efficient computing via signal folding
records.description: An in-hardware signal-folding scheme, which can be applied to one-transistor–one-resistor molybdenum disulfide arrays, can simultaneously achieve high weight precision and energy efficiency.

records.title: Reply to: Two-dimensional β-TeO 2 as an intrinsic insulator despite conflicting transport signatures
Searching for success with semiconductor start-ups for artificial intelligence
Giant gate response of the charge in an electron–lattice condensate
records.description: The carrier density of a charge-density-wave condensate can be directly and strongly modulated by electrical gating in orthorhombic tantalum trisulfide nanowires.

records.title: Sensing exceptional potential
records.description: Electronic circuits operated at exceptional points could be used to create powerful sensors, but challenges — particularly those related to noise — remain to be addressed.

records.title: Multielectrode arrays to visualize electrical signals in plants
records.description: A dry multielectrode array can be used to visualize propagating electrical signals in plants with high-curvature tissues.

records.title: Direct visualization of environment-stimulated electrical signals in plants using low-drift dry electrodes
records.description: Low-drift electrode arrays—based on a dry and conductive composite material made from an MXene and a pressure-sensitive adhesive—can be used to spatiotemporally map electrical signal propagation in plants such as Mimosa pudica .

records.title: Artificial neurons made with printed memristors
A bit-parallel molybdenum disulfide computer built through multi-level co-optimization
records.description: By combining a 0.5-μm industrial fabrication process and a back-end-of-line academia laboratory process, as well as using a multi-level co-optimization methodology, a molybdenum disulfide computer can be fabricated that comprises 1,433 transistors interconnected by four metal layers.

records.title: A robot that’s hard to love
An acoustic patch for gastric surgery
Interfacing biological neural networks with three-dimensional devices
records.description: A three-dimensional micro-fabricated neural interface device can provide volumetric electrical stimulation and recording within biological neural networks.

records.title: A large-scale stretchable neuromorphic circuit for on-body edge computing
records.description: A photolithographic fabrication process can be used to create soft and stretchy organic electrochemical transistor arrays that have a density up to 10,000 devices per square centimetre, and can perform edge computing tasks in wearable devices and soft robots.

records.title: High-performance p-type monolayer tungsten diselenide transistors
records.description: Using an industry-compatible and tunable oxygen-incorporated technique to heal defect states, p-type monolayer tungsten diselenide transistors can be created with a hole mobility of 137 cm 2 V −1 s −1 and a contact resistance of approximately 560 Ω µm at room temperature.

records.title: Scalable heterostructure contacts for power-efficient logic-in-memory
records.description: A scalable patterning method can create atomically sharp two-dimensional metal–semiconductor junctions, providing functional electrical contacts for logic-in-memory computing.

records.title: Non-volatile memories based on patterned metal–semiconductor heterostructures of niobium disulfide and molybdenum disulfide
records.description: Patterned and scalable two-dimensional metal–semiconductor heterostructures formed between niobium disulfide and molybdenum disulfide can be created using an in situ sulfurization process and used to make field-effect transistors and non-volatile memory devices.

records.title: Woodworking-inspired mechanical metainterfaces show improved energy transport
records.description: Interfaces are the main bottleneck for electrical and thermal transport through materials. Now, inspired by ancient carpentry joints, mechanical metainterfaces are developed that increase electrical transport and heat dissipation, with potential applications in electronics and power systems.

records.title: A universal stretchable cable
records.description: A core–shell cable that combines extreme elasticity with robust electrical performance can be used to bridge a range of terminal electronics including soft, rigid and hybrid electronic modules.

records.title: Zeptojoule calorimetry
records.description: A metallic superconductor–normal-conductor–superconductor sensor can be used to measure the energy of 1-μs-long 8.4-GHz microwave pulses with a full-width at half-maximum energy resolution finer than 0.95 ± 0.02 zJ, corresponding to 170 photons at 8.4 GHz.

records.title: Physical unclonable functions based on chaotic vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers for dynamic authentication
records.description: By using chaotic vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers as entropy sources for key generation, a security system based on physical unclonable functions can be created that offers response rates above 500 Gbps with an energy consumption below 1 pJ per bit per laser emitter.

records.title: Flexible radio-frequency carbon nanotube transistors operating at frequencies above 100 GHz
records.description: An electrothermal co-design strategy can be used to make flexible transistors based on aligned carbon nanotube arrays with current-gain cut-off frequencies of 152 GHz and power-gain cut-off frequencies of 102 GHz.

records.title: A reconfigurable skyrmion device for communications and sensing applications
records.description: A programmable topological platform is developed that uses eight positive–intrinsic–negative (PIN) diodes to dynamically control plasmonic skyrmions. This device achieves robust wireless communications in noisy environments and, when combined with a convolutional neural network, recognizes objects with 98.33% accuracy.

records.title: Carpentry-inspired interfaces for improved electronic and thermal transport
records.description: Metainterfaces that have repetitive surface unit structures, and are inspired by the mortise–tenon and finger-joint structures used in traditional woodworking, can be used to create functional interfaces with enhanced electronic and thermal transport.

records.title: Asymmetric thermal transport in a trilayer van der Waals heterostructure
records.description: By tuning the twist angle at its interfaces, a trilayer van der Waals heterostructure of molybdenum disulfide/molybdenum sulfide selenide/tungsten diselenide can offer an asymmetric thermal transport for use in the thermal management of electronic devices.

records.title: Building bioelectronics that stick around
records.description: A three-dimensional topological interpenetrating architecture can be used to reinforce the interfaces of bioelectronic devices, providing chronically stable in vivo signal recording and stimulation.

records.title: Abrasion-resistant bioelectronics based on a three-dimensional topological architecture and covalent chemical anchoring
records.description: Bioelectronics based on a three-dimensional topological interpenetrating architecture reinforced with covalent chemical anchoring can be used for long-term electrophysiological recording, electrical stimulation and electrochemical sensing in body locations subjected to constant movement.

records.title: Parity–time symmetry and exceptional points in electronic circuits
records.description: This Review explores parity–time (PT) symmetry and exceptional points in electronic circuits, considering the fundamental principles and implementations of PT symmetry in electronics and highlighting the key applications of such systems, including telemetry, sensing, hardware encryption and wireless power transfer.

records.title: Chasing the ohm
records.description: The ohm has been the unit of electric resistance for more than 150 years, but what we exactly mean by ‘a resistance of x ohm’ has evolved in terms of both meaning and magnitude during that time. Its realization has changed from mercury columns to mechanical constructs, and is now linked to immutable constants and embodied in the quantum Hall effect.

records.title: A symmetry-reconfigurable photodiode for sensing and computing
records.description: A photodiode that is based on silver bismuth sulfide offering a reversible symmetry-to-asymmetry transition via the localized electrochemical reduction of silver ions can be used for both transmissive imaging and in-sensor processing.

records.title: Ultrasound tracking on the move
records.description: Wearable ultrasound technology, when combined with machine learning algorithms, is now capable of complex hand tracking, bringing applications in spatial computing — and beyond — closer to reality.

records.title: Solid neon as a noise-resilient host for electron qubits above 100 mK
records.description: Solid neon can serve as a host for electron qubits that is resilient against charge and thermal noise, and exhibits a charge noise that is comparable to that of common semiconductor systems, as shown by noise spectroscopy.

records.title: Programmable skyrmions for communication and sensing
records.description: A programmable platform that encodes plasmonic skyrmions with diverse topologies, including Néel-type skyrmions and merons, can be used for robust wireless communication and intelligent sensing.

records.title: Signal-folding-based neuromorphic hardware for energy-efficient computing
records.description: Two types of signal folding—for input signals and for weight conductance—can be implemented in molybdenum disulfide-based one-transistor–one-resistor arrays to decrease power consumption and improve weight precision in vector–matrix multiplication.

records.title: Wafer-scale integration of single-crystalline molybdenum disulfide for flexible electronics using oxide dry transfer
records.description: A wafer-scale, solvent- and polymer-free transfer method that uses a high- κ dielectric oxide as the transfer medium can create molybdenum disulfide transistors on flexible substrates with high mobilities, high on/off ratios and near-ideal subthreshold slopes.

records.title: Quantum dot displays by dynamic transfer printing
A three-dimensional micro-instrumented neural network device
records.description: A three-dimensional soft electronic sensor and stimulator array that is integrated with a three-dimensional cultured neural network can be used to record action potential from multiple planes over a period of 6 months, monitor evolving connectivity maps and pharmacological responses, as well as construct a reservoir neural network for biocomputing.

records.title: Thermoelectric films with hierarchical pores
A compact spin-torque microwave detector
Optical dispersion using micro-vortices in thermoplastic polymers for integrated microspectrometers
records.description: Ultrafast-laser-fabricated micro-vortices in thermoplastic polymer substrates can be used to generate intricate microscale dispersion signals and be integrated with image sensors to create microspectrometers for spectral imaging.

records.title: The future of electronic sensors based on exceptional points
records.description: Non-Hermitian electronic sensors that exploit exceptional points and parity-time symmetry can offer enhanced sensitivity. But developing these sensors further will require a comprehensive understanding of the impact of noise and finding ways to enhance the complexity of both linear and nonlinear systems.

records.title: Intrinsically stretchable complementary circuits based on direct photo-patternable polymer semiconductors
records.description: Intrinsically stretchable logic gates and ring oscillators with stable performance up to 100% strain can be fabricated using complementary circuits that are solution processed and based on direct photo-patternable polymer semiconductors.

records.title: An implantable epiretinal device for near-infrared light perception
records.description: An artificial retina consisting of near-infrared-sensitive phototransistors and three-dimensional liquid metal electrodes can be adhered to the epiretinal surface to stimulate retinal ganglion cells, extending vision in mice with a retinal degenerative disease.

records.title: A battery-free wireless epidermal sensor network for continuous systolic blood pressure monitoring
records.description: A sensor network that is wirelessly interconnected through a dual-mode metamaterial integrated into clothing can continuously monitor systolic blood pressure in dynamic environments such as during exercise.

records.title: A chip-scale image sensor integrated with a microelectromechanical system actuator
records.description: A chip-scale image sensor that uses a microelectromechanical system actuator to modulate the sensor’s position can enhance the spatial bandwidth product by up to 33.7-fold compared with operation without actuation.

records.title: Artificial intelligence-powered ultrasound wristband tracks full hand motion
records.description: Hand tracking is vital for interacting with virtual and physical environments, but current technologies face various limitations, including visual obstructions and discrete tracking. Now, a wearable ultrasound imaging wristband integrated with artificial intelligence continuously tracks all 22 degrees of freedom of the hand, providing intuitive control for various applications.

records.title: Growing single-crystalline antimony oxide with van der Waals epitaxy
records.description: Atomically thin single-crystalline high- κ dielectrics can be grown directly on a two-dimensional semiconductor by van der Waals epitaxy, providing ultrathin gate stacks with excellent interface quality.

records.title: In-memory processing takes spectrometers to the edge
records.description: A memristor chip can provide fast and energy-efficient spectrum analysis by using robust and denoised in-memory computing memory arrays.

records.title: A three-dimensional stretchable core–shell cable for soft and hybrid electronics that is patternable, recyclable and noise-resistant
records.description: A soft three-dimensional core–shell cable can form reliable free-standing interconnects between soft, rigid and hybrid electronic components, and can be stretched by up to around 800%.

records.title: Low-temperature wafer-scale growth of ultrathin tungsten disulfide for bifunctional interconnect barriers and liners
records.description: Thin and conformal tungsten disulfide (WS 2 ) layers, which are grown at the wafer scale using thermal atomic layer deposition at back-end-of-line compatible temperatures, can function as both barriers and liners for interconnects.

records.title: Untangling the challenges of quantum computing
records.description: From scaling to error correction, numerous problems remain to be addressed before a practical quantum computer can be built, but researchers continue to find the necessary solutions.

records.title: Radiofrequency cascade readout of coupled spin qubits
records.description: A dispersive sensing technique, termed the radiofrequency electron cascade, can perform singlet-triplet readout of two exchange-coupled electron spins in a natural silicon planar metal–oxide–semiconductor quantum-dot array.

records.title: A pulse-train generator with adaptive frequency tracking
A chip that can track wasps
Smart glasses controlled by neural signals
Hand tracking using wearable wrist imaging
records.description: A fully integrated, wireless ultrasound imaging wristband—combined with an artificial intelligence algorithm—can be used to track arbitrary hand configurations of the five fingers and the palm in real time during daily activities with a delay of less than 120 ms.

records.title: In-sensor cryptographic signature generation to link a physical process and an immutable digital entity
records.description: A monolithic cryptographic sensor, which integrates a sensor device with a hashing unit and a cryptographic signature unit, can be used to create a recording system that provides a cryptographic link between a physical process and an immutable digital entity.

records.title: A CMOS controller for nitrogen–vacancy centre spins
In situ spectral reconstruction based on a memristor chip for energy-efficient computational spectrometry
records.description: An in situ computational spectrometer, implemented on a fully integrated 576-Kb memristor chip, can reconstruct a single spectrum in 125.0 ns and consumes only 6.7 nJ of energy, achieving software-equivalent accuracy.

records.title: High-mobility holes in gallium nitride and their quantum oscillations
records.description: High hole mobilities in a polarization-induced two-dimensional hole gas at a gallium nitride/aluminium nitride interface can allow Shubnikov–de Haas oscillations of light and heavy holes to be observed in gallium nitride.

records.title: A single diode with integrated photosensing, memory and processing for neuromorphic image sensors
records.description: By forming an electron reservoir in the centre of a gallium nitride nanowire p–n diode, a single two-terminal device can be created that offers sensing, memory and synaptic functionalities, and arrays of such devices can be used to denoise and identify optical images.

records.title: Cold quantum bits connected by a hot wire
records.description: Single microwave photons can be transferred through a hot quantum channel.

records.title: Low-resistance contacts for p-type monolayer tungsten diselenide transistors using metallic layered Nb 0.3 W 0.7 Se 2
records.description: A two-dimensional/two-dimensional contact of metallic Nb 0 . 3 W 0 . 7 Se 2 and tungsten diselenide can be used to make p-type transistors with channel lengths of 100 nm and on-currents of over 1.1 mA µm⁻¹.

records.title: Detecting quantum errors with solid-state nuclear spins
records.description: Single-qubit errors can be detected in a system composed of four nuclear spin qubits and one electron spin qubit.

records.title: A quantum computer controlled by superconducting digital electronics at millikelvin temperature
records.description: An active quantum processor unit can be created by integrating qubits and single-flux quantum control electronics into a single multi-chip module using flip-chip bonding.

records.title: Ultrathin and robust elastomeric dielectrics using a crosslinking-assisted trap creation method for miniaturized stretchable electronics
records.description: Multiarmed crosslinkers can be used to reduce the free volume in elastomer networks and create deep trap states, increasing the breakdown strength of sub-100-nm elastomer dielectric films.

records.title: Memristors march on
records.description: From cellular neural networks to human–machine interfaces, the applications of memristors continue to grow.

records.title: A nonlinear Hall rectenna in NbIrTe 4
records.description: A rectenna that offers rectification and frequency mixing for gigahertz and terahertz waves can be created using the nonlinear Hall effect in the Weyl semimetal niobium iridium tetratelluride (NbIrTe 4 ).

records.title: A thermal-noise-resilient microwave quantum network up to 4 K
records.description: A microwave quantum network that uses a 4-K-thermalized niobium–titanium transmission line provides coherent coupling between 2 superconducting qubits with a quantum state transfer process fidelity of 58.5% and a Bell entanglement fidelity of 52.3%.

records.title: Epitaxially grown single-crystalline antimony trioxide dielectrics for two-dimensional electronics
records.description: An in situ epitaxial method can be used to grow thin films of antimony trioxide directly on two-dimensional semiconductors, such as tungsten diselenide, creating transfer-free dielectric gate stacks.

records.title: An all-in-one Hall rectenna with a bandwidth over 100 GHz
records.description: A nonlinear Hall rectenna based on the type-II Weyl semimetal niobium iridium tetratelluride (NbIrTe 4 ) can offer 27th-order nonlinear frequency comb generation and high-bandwidth mixing exceeding 100 GHz.

records.title: Building two-dimensional microprocessors with a foundry-inspired strategy
records.description: A foundry-inspired workflow — developed through 130 batches of test-driven process optimization — can be used to fabricate wafer-scale integrated circuits based on monolayer molybdenum disulfide transistors with high yields and a fully interconnected 120-transistor microprocessor.

records.title: A towards-foundry strategy for creating fully interconnected two-dimensional microprocessors
records.description: A fully interconnected microprocessor based on two-dimensional molybdenum disulfide transistors can be fabricated using an iterative testing and optimization strategy at the level of materials, individual transistors and circuit modules.

records.title: Communication-aware in-memory wireless neural networks
records.description: By using analogue in-memory computing technology to integrate edge computing and wireless communication into a learnable system, communication-aware in-memory wireless neural networks can be created that can adapt to different wireless conditions.

records.title: A communication system that operates in space
High-temperature operation of group-III nitride high-electron-mobility transistors
records.description: This Review examines the degradation mechanisms and lifetime-limiting behaviour of critical device layers in group-III nitride high-electron-mobility transistors under high-temperature operation, considering how these impact device- and circuit-level performance under high thermal stress and highlighting the challenges that need to be addressed to achieve reliable operation in extreme conditions.

records.title: Stirring up vortices with hydrogel cilia
Long-term health monitoring of poorly plants
A crossbar chip for benchmarking semiconductor spin qubits
records.description: A scalable architecture that is based on a quantum dot crossbar array comprising tightly pitched spin-qubit tiles and implemented in planar germanium, can be used characterize spin qubits.

records.title: Flexible kirigami microelectrode arrays for neuronal activity recordings in non-human primate brains
records.description: A flexible, floating microelectrode array that has a reconfigurable spiral thread design can be used to create large-scale, long-term brain–computer interfaces in the primate brain.

records.title: Author Correction: Metallic charge transport in conjugated molecular bilayers
Fully autonomous tuning of a spin qubit
records.description: An algorithm that combines deep learning, Bayesian optimization and computer vision techniques can be used to autonomously tune a semiconductor spin qubit from a grounded device to Rabi oscillations.

records.title: Robot reasons
records.description: Robotics is our 2026 technology of the year.

records.title: General collective intelligence for multi-robot systems
records.description: Enhancing the generality of multi-robot systems is critical for their deployment in open-world applications. Achieving this will require the development of general collective intelligence.

records.title: It is either body or brain first when building autonomous microrobots
records.description: Microscopic robots (microrobots) with integrated electronic chips have a range of potential medical, environmental and industrial applications. However, such systems have only recently become mass-producible, using either a body-first or a brain-first approach to fabrication.

records.title: The potential of miniaturized ingestible electronics
records.description: Ingestible electronic devices could transform gastrointestinal medicine by combining diagnostic and therapeutic functions into a single miniature device. But challenges related to device miniaturization, power-efficient integrated circuit design and data security remain to be addressed.

records.title: Using electronics to build biohybrid robots with physical intelligence
records.description: Biohybrid robots, which rely on living muscles to drive force generation, could be of use in applications ranging from microsurgery to unmanned exploration. But the development of untethered and autonomous machines will require the integration of onboard electronics for sensing, control and power.

records.title: Quantum error detection in a silicon quantum processor
records.description: A four-qubit quantum error detection circuit with stabilizers can be implemented with spin qubits in a donor-based silicon quantum processor.

records.title: Flexible magnet-based antennas that can see through rock
A metalens array for centimetre-scale three-dimensional lithography
A microscopic robot with onboard closed-loop control
Van der Waals heterostructures go multiferroic
records.description: Magnetic anisotropy in multiferroic van der Waals heterostructures can be electrically controlled, providing non-volatile and low-power operations driven by ferroelectric switching.

records.title: Low-power memristor-based cellular neural networks with reduced overhead
records.description: Cellular neural networks enable real-time, parallel computation for tasks such as high-speed image processing and solving partial differential equations. We found that low-power memristors are well suited for synaptic weights in such networks, even at extreme temperatures, allowing a single system-on-a-chip to be reconfigured for different tasks.

records.title: Interferroic magnetoelectric coupling at CuCrP 2 S 6 /Fe 3 GeTe 2 van der Waals heterojunctions
records.description: A van der Waals heterostructure made from atomic layers of ferroelectric CuCrP 2 S 6 and ferromagnetic Fe 3 GeTe 2 can offer reversible, non-volatile ferroelectric control of two-dimensional magnetism.

records.title: A monolithic three-dimensional integrated red micro-LED display on silicon using AlInP/GaInP epilayers
records.description: A hole-dominant AlInP/GaInP double quantum well can be used to create red micro-light-emitting diode pixels with high internal quantum efficiency at low drive currents, as well as minimized size-dependent quantum efficiency shifts, allowing high-resolution active-matrix displays to be integrated on silicon complementary metal–oxide–semiconductor backplanes.

records.title: Metallic charge transport in conjugated molecular bilayers
records.description: Molecular bilayer crystals of an organic semiconductor can exhibit metallic charge transport down to 8 K with an electrical conductivity of up to 245 S cm −1 , as well as charge carrier mobility values of more than 100 cm 2 V −1 s −1 at 20 K.

records.title: Memristive cellular neural networks for fast in-pixel computing
records.description: A cellular neural network that incorporates transistors and multilevel non-volatile memristor synapses can be used for efficient image and video processing.

records.title: Enhanced signal-to-noise ratio with exceptional-point phase sensing
records.description: Phase-difference sensing in a nonlinear non-Hermitian electronic circuit can be used to improve the sensitivity of sensors.

records.title: A nonlinear parity–time-symmetric system for robust phase sensing
records.description: A wearable capacitive temperature sensor that is based on exceptional-point-enhanced phase sensing can measure temperatures from 36 °C to 55.5 °C—a perturbation from 0% to 3.95%—with a maximum normalized sensitivity of 400, an estimated dynamic range of 53.52 dB and an estimated signal-to-noise ratio of 63.8 dB.

records.title: An end-to-end memristive hardware system based on single-spike coding for human–machine interfaces
records.description: A neuromorphic system that consists of vanadium oxide memristors for the accurate encoding of information as single spikes, and hafnium oxide/tantalum oxide memristors with programming strategies to limit conductance drift, can reliably perform computations using efficient single-spike coding schemes.

records.title: Spiking neural networks with fatigue spike-timing-dependent plasticity learning using hybrid memristor arrays
records.description: By coupling volatile memristors with short-term dynamics and non-volatile memristors with long-term dynamics, spiking neural network hardware can be created that exhibits fatigue spike-timing-dependent plasticity learning.

records.title: A photonically linked memristive neural network
records.description: Transmission of information via photons could lead to compact three-dimensional neuromorphic computing hardware.

records.title: Heat-shrinking method for the fabrication of conformal electronics
records.description: A heat-shrinking method for fabricating conformal electronics is realized by patterning semi-liquid metal circuits onto thermoplastic substrates that are then heated to induce shrinkage around a three-dimensional target object. The method can be applied to diverse targets of different shapes and sizes, with the shape-adaptive electronics showing good electrical stability.

records.title: A fully integrated analogue closed-loop in-memory computing accelerator based on static random-access memory
records.description: A closed-loop in-memory computing accelerator, implemented in a fully integrated chip with on-chip mixed-signal circuits, can be used to solve multiple inverse matrix–vector problems.

records.title: Manipulating thousands of non-volatile polarization states within one sliding ferroelectric transistor at room temperature
records.description: Using 36 polarization states generated at 84 doping levels, 3,024 physically distinct polarization states can be achieved at room temperature in a sliding ferroelectric transistor that is composed of an aligned graphene monolayer atop hexagonal boron nitride.

records.title: Author Correction: Scaled crystalline antimony ohmic contacts for two-dimensional transistors
Approaching optimal microwave–acoustic transduction on lithium niobate using superconducting quantum interference device arrays
records.description: By using superconducting quantum interference device arrays as microwave impedance transformers, piezoelectric microwave–acoustic transduction operating close to the maximal efficiency–bandwidth product of lithium niobate can be achieved.

records.title: Shape-adaptive electronics based on liquid metal circuits printed on thermoplastic films
records.description: A heat-shrinking method—in which semi-liquid metal-based circuits are printed on thermoplastic films that subsequently shrink and wrap around a target object when mildly heated—can be used to create conformal electronics on various substrates, including plants and skin.

records.title: A first-principles hetero-integrated Fourier transform system based on memristors
records.description: Using volatile vanadium oxide and non-volatile tantalum oxide/hafnium oxide memristor arrays, a first-principles Fourier transform system can be created that can outperform conventional Fourier transform hardware in terms of throughput and reduce memory cost.

records.title: Photonically linked three-dimensional neural networks based on memristive blinking neurons
records.description: A memristive blinking neuron—relying on atomic-scale filamentary dynamics for resistive switching and emitting photon pulses on integrating a critical number of incoming electrical spikes—can be used to build photonically linked three-dimensional spiking neural networks.

records.title: High-power millimetre-wave switches on silicon using displacement fields and tunnelling currents
records.description: Terahertz switches that are based on a zero-change silicon-on-insulator process—and operate through the electrical control of displacement fields and tunnelling currents in the interface between polycrystalline and bulk silicon—can achieve sub-30-ps switching.

records.title: High-power millimetre-wave switches on silicon using displacement fields and tunnelling currents
records.description: Terahertz switches that are based on a zero-change silicon-on-insulator process—and operate through the electrical control of displacement fields and tunnelling currents in the interface between polycrystalline and bulk silicon—can achieve sub-30-ps switching.

records.title: A neuromorphic imager based on a cascaded optoelectronic synapse
records.description: An optoelectronic device that converts light into a postsynaptic signal after two stages of cascaded potentiation can mimic the synaptic facilitation function of the human retina and could be used to create a curvy neuromorphic imager.

records.title: A scalable superconducting nanowire memory array with row–column addressing
records.description: Arrays of nanowire loops consisting of two temperature-dependent superconducting switches and a variable kinetic inductor can be used to create a robust and scalable superconducting memory.

records.title: Body sensor networks based on flexible topological clothing
records.description: Topological metamaterial clothing based on metallic conductive textiles can be used to create robust biosensing networks on the human body that can monitor vital signs during exercise.

records.title: A fully packaged cryogenic optical transmitter directly interfaced with a superconducting chip
records.description: An electronic–photonic transmitter chip can enable signal readout of superconducting electronics for interfacing with room-temperature environments.

records.title: Fatigue-resistant metal-film-based flexible conductors with a coherent gradient nanolayered architecture
records.description: Conductive films with a coherent gradient nanolayered architecture that consists of alternating stacked silver and aluminium layers can suppress crack nucleation and propagation, leading to increased resistance to mechanical cyclic fatigue.
